split.protocol: chronological 60/20/20; observed past test symbols may appear in later contexts; frozen weights

source_metadata.oracle_scope: P(X_t | observed X_0,...,X_{t-1}, known parameters and t)
source_metadata.rule: X[t]=2 U[t]+V[t]; iid fair U; V[t]=(U[t-a] if U[t-selector] else U[t-b]) XOR noise.
source_metadata.uniformity_proof: Distinct lagged iid fair driver bits make multiplexer output fair; fresh U[t] is independent of V[t], so each symbol has probability 1/4.
source_metadata.initialization: First max(lags) symbols iid uniform; recurrent rule follows. Finite prefix is a documented nonstationary initialization.

metrics.success_ci_target: realized test-trajectory average of E[success_t | information before X_t]; predictor and model selection must be fixed before the final test
metrics.bootstrap_assumptions: Exploratory circular-block percentile interval; requires a stationary, sufficiently mixing score process, suitable block length and enough blocks. Not justified for drift, arbitrary dependence, or very long memory.

limitations: Predictor performance does not certify a lower bound on source min-entropy.
Martingale intervals target trajectory-average conditional success, not future stationary risk.
Block bootstrap is exploratory under stationarity and suitable mixing, invalid generally for drift.
Memory is sampled whole-process RSS, not isolated model allocations.
Repeated exploration of final tests invalidates confirmatory interpretation.
